<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1297
Claimant:
Derrick Mccoy
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
07/05/2024
Claim opeend after the insured reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant's
vehicle was reported as the other vehicle involved, and the claimant is represented by counsel, so all contact will go
through the attorney's office.
07/10/2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is named on it and that coverage was active on the date of
loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
07/11/2024
Photos from the insured's phone show damage along the passenger side of the vehicle, and the pattern is consistent
with the impact described. No independent witnesses have come forward so far.
07/14/2024
Responding officer's report confirms the claimant was present in the other vehicle at the scene. Vehicle damage on
the claimant's car matches the reported impact point, and no prior damage to that area is on record.
07/17/2024
Recorded a first statement from the claimant through counsel. The account describes the same sequence of events
given at the scene, and the claimant reported neck and back strain that is a plausible result of a collision of this kind.
08/06/2024
Obtained the initial medical report. Treatment so far is limietd and in line with what is typically expected for a neck and
back strain. No prior injury to the same body areas is known.
08/07/2024
Follow-up call with counsel to confirm the claimant's account has not changed. The description of the lane change
and point of contact matches the earlier statement.
10/05/2024
Treatment frequency has increased to nearly every day, and the claimant has been seen at a rate many times the
usual for this injury. Additional body areas have been added in treatment notes several weeks after the crash.
10/06/2024
Requested itemized treatment records and a provider summary to understand the increase in visits and the newly
reported areas. Counsel has been informed the request is pending.
12/02/2024
Reviewed the records received so far. The escalation in care is documented, but the provider notes give the reason
for each added area, and no earlier injury to those areas appears in the prior records obtained.
12/08/2024
Spoke again with the claimant thruogh counsel. The account of how the collision happened remains the same as in
every prior conversation. Further medical review has been requested beofre any evaluation is made.
12/19/2024
File remains open pending the medical review and the remaining treatment records. Next step is to schedule the
independent medical review and reassess the claim once that report is returned.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
